description: gate renders handoff/gate.md from gate-items.json and the extracted drafts (texts copied by the script, never by the phase agent), replaying every draft per target file in gate order against the Orient text: two drafts with the same current_text are a conflict group, an insert at the end of a file with no final newline is a glue problem, and an edit that pushes a verify-mass row over its pin gets a Budget line. extract normalizes an insert's new_text to end in a blank line. A drafts.json item missing from gate-items.json is refused. gate --decisions replays the Applied items in decisions.json order and exits 1 on a conflict or an over pin; an Applied target uncommitted at Orient is a problem line, and two identical inserts collide. handoff check refuses a gate.md edited after gate wrote it. A merge item comes after its sources and its drafter data carries their drafts; a merge that fell back leaves the merge item out and its sources listed. A gate with no drafted item needs no drafts.json.
